# U.S. Core Inflation Rate (Jan 2015 - Dec 2016)

Below is the U.S. Core CPI (Consumer Price Index excluding food and energy) year-over-year percentage change:

| Month | 2015 | 2016 |
|-------|------|------|
| January | 1.6% | 2.2% |
| February | 1.7% | 2.3% |
| March | 1.8% | 2.2% |
| April | 1.8% | 2.1% |
| May | 1.7% | 2.2% |
| June | 1.8% | 2.3% |
| July | 1.8% | 2.2% |
| August | 1.8% | 2.3% |
| September | 1.9% | 2.2% |
| October | 1.9% | 2.1% |
| November | 2.0% | 2.1% |
| December | 2.1% | 2.2% |

**Source:** U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS)

**Note:** Core inflation excludes volatile food and energy prices to show underlying inflation trends. These figures represent year-over-year percentage changes in the Core CPI.

*Please verify these figures with official BLS data for critical use, as my knowledge may contain minor discrepancies.*
